headline: Graphical dependence and mediation methods for high-dimensional biomedical covariates
label: Graphical Models In Biomedical Data
summary: Recent 2026 work extends graphical and mediation models to high-dimensional biomedical covariates, including UK Biobank and All of Us data.
synthesis: The dominant thread is structured dependence among high-dimensional biomedical covariates, addressed through explicit graphical or latent-structure modeling. SurvGME pairs graphical dependence among covariates, such as gene expression, with measurement error in survival analysis, while the multiVCBART preprint places Graphical Horseshoe priors on sparse residual dependence within a multivariate varying-coefficient BART model. On the mediation side, a PCBI study combines outcome-adaptive LASSO with causal mediation for continuous treatments in UK Biobank data, and an All of Us preprint uses VAE-based multimodal representation learning to recover latent mediation structure linking socioeconomic disadvantage to cardiometabolic multimorbidity. What is new is joint treatment of covariate graph structure, measurement error, and mediation within the same inferential frameworks rather than in separate pipelines.
